WITH
          upd_users AS (
            UPDATE users
            SET email            = $2,
                password_hash    = NULL,
                phone            = NULL,
                phone_verified   = false,
                email_verified   = false,
                status           = 'deleted',
                deleted_at       = now()
            WHERE id = $1
          )
        UPDATE profiles
        SET display_name       = NULL,
            about              = NULL,
            position           = NULL,
            body_type          = NULL,
            height_cm          = NULL,
            weight_kg          = NULL,
            relationship_status = NULL,
            gender_identity    = NULL,
            pronouns           = NULL,
            hiv_status         = NULL,
            last_tested_on     = NULL,
            prep               = NULL,
            profile_photo_id   = NULL,
            profile_photo_key  = NULL,
            details            = '{}'::jsonb
        WHERE user_id = $1
